{{Quote|So what's the scandal? That he's a married man, that he dates a protester, or that he's obviously got lousy taste in holovids?|Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="no prisoners" />}}
[[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senator]] [[Herbin]] was [[Marriage/Legends|married]] to an '''individual''' sometime before [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="no prisoners" /> That [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> he began cheating on his spouse with a [[Holovid/Legends|holovid]] [[Unidentified actress|actress]]. The affair was widely publicized over [[HoloNet News and Entertainment]].<ref name="no prisoners" />

==Behind the scenes==
Herbin's spouse was mentioned in ''[[The Clone Wars: No Prisoners]]'', which was released in [[2009]] and written by [[Karen Traviss]] as part of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' multimedia project.<ref name="no prisoners" />
